ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC$ is rotated $60^\circ$ clockwise around point $A$ to obtain $\triangle AED$. If the length of segment $AB=4$, what is the length of $BE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC$ is rotated $60^\circ$ clockwise around point A to get $\triangle AED$,\\
it follows that $AB=AE$ and $\angle BAE=60^\circ$.\\
Thus, $\triangle AEB$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
which means $BE=AB$.\\
Given $AB=4$,\\
it follows that $BE=\boxed{4}$.
